title: 1 John Bible Quiz - Chapter 4
description: Ten questions on 1 John 4: testing the spirits, God is love, the Son sent as Savior of the world, and perfect love that casts out fear.

questions.text: Why does the letter tell them to test the spirits?
questions.explanation: 1 John 4:1 tells them not to believe every spirit but to test them, because many false prophets have gone out into the world.

answers.text: Because many false prophets have gone out into the world
Because prophets no longer speak at all
Because the world listens to God
Because the last hour has already passed

questions.text: Which spirit is of God, according to the letter?
questions.explanation: 1 John 4:2 says that every spirit who confesses that Jesus Christ has come in the flesh is of God.

answers.text: Every spirit who works great signs and wonders
Every spirit who confesses that Jesus Christ has come in the flesh
Every spirit who speaks about the law of Moses
Every spirit who speaks with great boldness

questions.text: Why have the little children overcome them, according to the letter?
questions.explanation: 1 John 4:4 says they are of God and have overcome them, because greater is he who is in them than he who is in the world.

answers.text: Because they are many in number and strong
Because they hold the oldest teaching of all
Because greater is he who is in them than he who is in the world
Because the world is small and very weak

questions.text: What does the letter say God is?
questions.explanation: 1 John 4:8 says that he who does not love does not know God, for God is love.

answers.text: A judge
A shepherd
A witness
Love

questions.text: How was God's love revealed in us, according to the letter?
questions.explanation: 1 John 4:9 says God's love was revealed in us in that he sent his one and only Son into the world, so that we might live through him.

answers.text: He sent his one and only Son into the world
He gave us the law from the mountain
He sent us his prophets with warnings
He made the world and all that is in it

questions.text: What does the letter say about seeing God?
questions.explanation: 1 John 4:12 says that no one has seen God at any time, but if we love one another God remains in us.

answers.text: Only the prophets have seen God
All who love have seen God
No one has seen God at any time
The angels show God to us

questions.text: What do they testify that the Father has sent the Son to be?
questions.explanation: 1 John 4:14 says they have seen and testify that the Father has sent the Son as the Savior of the world.

answers.text: A judge of the angels
The last of the prophets
A teacher for Israel only
The Savior of the world

questions.text: What does perfect love do, according to the letter?
questions.explanation: 1 John 4:18 says there is no fear in love, and that perfect love casts out fear, because fear has punishment.

answers.text: It brings punishment
It casts out fear
It hides fear away
It makes fear holy

questions.text: Why do we love him, according to the letter?
questions.explanation: 1 John 4:19 says we love him because he first loved us.

answers.text: Because he first loved us
Because we keep his law
Because we fear his judgment
Because we have seen him

questions.text: What does the letter call a man who says "I love God" and hates his brother?
questions.explanation: 1 John 4:20 says such a man is a liar, since he who does not love the brother he has seen cannot love God whom he has not seen.

answers.text: A weak believer
A wise teacher
A liar
A stranger to the world
